name: io.github.bgts-ai-org/bgts-context-engine
title: BGTS Context Engine
description: Deterministic code-graph context for AI coding agents over PostgreSQL, Apache AGE and pgvector

runtimeArguments.name: --from
runtimeArguments.description: The MCP surface lives behind the 'mcp' extra; the REST API does not need it.
Console script installed by the package.

packageArguments.description: Serve the MCP tools over stdio (eight read-only, two more with BCE_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE=true).

environmentVariables.name: BCE_DB_HOST
environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL host running Apache AGE and pgvector.

environmentVariables.name: BCE_ENV_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional .env with every BCE_* setting (written by `bce cursor-init`); values set here override it.

environmentVariables.name: BCE_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Encoder the index was built with: voyage (hosted, needs BCE_VOYAGE_API_KEY), openai (your own OpenAI-compatible server, needs BCE_EMBEDDING_BASE_URL) or hashing (offline). Leave unset when BCE_ENV_FILE sets it: environment values win over the file.

environmentVariables.name: BCE_EMBEDDING_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Embedding model id the index was built with (voyage-code-4, jina-code-embeddings-1.5b, ...).

environmentVariables.name: BCE_EMBEDDING_DIM
environmentVariables.description: Vector width the index was built with (voyage-code-4: 1024, jina-code-embeddings-1.5b: 1536).

environmentVariables.name: BCE_EMBEDDING_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible embedding server (provider openai), e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8001/v1.

environmentVariables.name: BCE_EMBEDDING_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token of that server; empty for a server without auth.

environmentVariables.name: BCE_SELECTOR
environmentVariables.description: Optional context selector: off (unset), jev (needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY), decider-4b / decider-2b (needs BCE_SELECTOR_URL).

environmentVariables.name: BCE_SELECTOR_URL
environmentVariables.description: Decider server endpoint for BCE_SELECTOR=decider-4b / decider-2b, e.g. http://<host>:<port>/v1/systemone.
